in_marathi.name: Binay
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Son of Wisdom
in_marathi.long_meaning: Binay हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Binay is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'Bina' meaning 'without' and 'Vidyam' meaning 'knowledge'. This name signifies a son who is born without the need for knowledge, as he embodies it himself. In Hindu mythology, Binay is often associated with the god Vishnu, who is the preserver of knowledge and wisdom.
